summary: The RBAC_settings.yml playbook runs on localhost with vars/all.yml and uses ansible.platform.organization, ansible.platform.team, ansible.platform.user and ansible.platform.role_definition (content_type awx.inventory with awx.view_inventory and awx.change_inventory) to create RBAC objects, passing the aap_* connection parameters.
questions: How do I create an organization with ansible.platform?
How do I create a custom role with ansible.platform.role_definition?
Example playbook to create AAP team and user as code
What content_type is used for inventory roles?

answer_card.title: Create RBAC objects with ansible.platform
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  vars_files: [./vars/all.yml]
  tasks:
    - ansible.platform.organization:
        name: "{{ org_name }}"
        state: present
        aap_hostname: "{{ aap_hostname }}"
        aap_username: "{{ aap_username }}"
        aap_password: "{{ aap_password }}"
    - ansible.platform.role_definition:
        name: "{{ custom_role_name }}"
        content_type: awx.inventory
        permissions: [awx.view_inventory, awx.change_inventory]
        state: present
        # aap_* connection parameters as above
```
Use `ansible.platform.team` and `ansible.platform.user` the same way.
